entries.access_note: Public Microsoft Learn documentation page, indexed without sign-in.
entries.evidence: Query: Microsoft Learn "4624(S): An account was successfully logged on" AND "4769(S, F): A Kerberos service ticket was requested" event auditing (learn.microsoft.com). Result title '4624(S) An account was successfully logged on. - Windows 10' at this URL; result text: generated on the computer that was accessed; its Logon GUID links to event 4769 on a domain controller. The 4769 page was returned under /previous-versions/windows/it-pro/windows-10/security/threat-protection/auditing/event-4769 and notes an updated 4769 format after the 2025-01-14 cumulative update.
entries.version: as listed 2026-11-18; the title still says Windows 10
entries.notes: Field reference for the D14 correlation of a user action with process and security records.

entries.title: Sysmon events
entries.access_note: Public Microsoft Learn documentation page, indexed without sign-in.
entries.evidence: Query: Microsoft Learn Sysmon events "Event ID 3: Network connection" "disabled by default" ... (learn.microsoft.com). Result title 'Sysmon events' at this URL; result text: Event ID 3 (network connection) is disabled by default and should be enabled selectively. Sibling results: 'Sysmon - Sysinternals' (learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sysinternals/downloads/sysmon), 'Sysmon Overview', 'Sysmon configuration files' and 'Read and tune Sysmon events on Windows' under the same /sysmon/ path.
entries.notes: Supports the plan's telemetry caveat: confirm the audit policy and the Sysmon configuration before expecting an event.

entries.title: Windows Server 2025
entries.access_note: Microsoft Evaluation Center (search result): registration is required before the download, at no charge; the evaluation edition expires in 180 days. The registration is a form, not a platform account.
entries.evidence: Query: Microsoft Evaluation Center Windows Server 2025 evaluation 180 days download (microsoft.com, learn.microsoft.com). Result title 'Windows Server 2025' at this URL; result text: 'This evaluation edition expires in 180 days'; ISO in several languages and a 64-bit VHD; 'Evaluation versions of Windows Server must be activated over the internet in the first 10 days to avoid automatic shutdown'.
entries.version: Windows Server 2025 evaluation, 180 days, as listed 2026-11-18
entries.notes: Licence caveat for the isolated lab: the result text says an evaluation must be activated over the internet within 10 days, which conflicts with a guest that has no internet route. Decide this in the lab design before D12. The download and any activation step are host changes that need separate approval. The workstation image (Windows 11 Enterprise evaluation) was not checked; see gaps.

entries.title: Kerberoasted
entries.access_note: The tier of this lab was not shown. CyberDefenders help centre (search results): Free Labs are open to all users, selected Pro Labs are 'Trial' labs with a one-time total of 5 hours per account (article about two years old), other labs need a paid plan; the lab list marks some labs PREMIUM.
entries.evidence: Query: cyberdefenders.org blueteam-ctf-challenges kerberoasted lab Threat Hunting Medium (cyberdefenders.org). This URL was returned with the page title 'Blue team CTF Challenges'; result text and the Threat Hunting track page name the lab 'Kerberoasted': Medium, 60 minutes, 9 questions, Splunk and ELK, investigate Kerberos logs and identify compromised accounts.
entries.notes: Provider-stated duration 60 minutes. Stretch option: it assumes SIEM query skills that the plan teaches in week 7. CyberDefenders publishes official walkthroughs for some labs under cyberdefenders.org/walkthroughs/: do not open one during the independent block.

Whether new sign-ups continue on letsdefend.io was not shown. Other LetsDefend courses returned without a free tag: 'Event Log Analysis' and 'Hunting AD Attacks' (both rated hard). The estimate is a registry planning figure sized to the block, not a provider figure.

plan_fact_checks.claim: HTB path duration: CPTS (Penetration Tester) path estimate 342 h and SOC Analyst path 189 h (plan section 4 and section 16 item 1).
plan_fact_checks.evidence: Query: help.hackthebox.com "Academy Modules & Paths" Penetration Tester path estimated hours 342 SOC Analyst 189. Result 'Academy Modules & Paths' at help.hackthebox.com/en/articles/12741910-academy-modules-paths: the table lists Penetration Tester (CPTS) 342 hours (42 days and 6 hours at 8 hours per day) and SOC Analyst (CDSA) 189 hours. Single source.

plan_fact_checks.claim: OSCP+ scaled scoring begins on 2026-12-01; no fixed 70-point target for exams on or after that date (plan section 4 and section 16 item 3).
plan_fact_checks.evidence: Query: OffSec OSCP+ "Equated Scaled Scoring" FAQ December 1 2026 exam scoring change passing score (help.offsec.com, offsec.com). Result 'OSCP+ Equated Scaled Scoring FAQ' at the plan's URL: exams that start before 2026-12-01 08:00 GMT keep the 70 raw-point pass mark; exams that start on or after it are reported on a 100 to 500 scale with 400 as the pass mark, the raw points needed depend on the exam set and are not published; results can take up to 15 business days. The OffSec blog post words the cut-off as 'exams taken through November 30, 2026'.

plan_fact_checks.claim: MITRE ATT&CK: review the October 2026 release (plan section 4).
plan_fact_checks.evidence: Query: MITRE ATT&CK latest release version October 2026 v19 release notes updates (attack.mitre.org). Results 'Updates - Updates - October 2026' and 'Version History': the October 2026 release is ATT&CK v20 (v19.2 ran until 2026-10-12; v20.1 is shown as current, and the site changelog lists a v20.1 content release dated 2026-11-05; the two dates for v20.1 do not agree in the results). v20 adds AI-related Enterprise techniques including Direct and Indirect Prompt Injection. v19 (April 2026) split the Defense Evasion tactic into Stealth and Defense Impairment, so material that names 'Defense Evasion' as a current tactic is outdated.

plan_fact_checks.claim: The OWASP list for LLM applications that is current is the 2026 edition at genai.owasp.org/resource/owasp-genai-llm-top-10-2026/ (plan section 4 and section 16 item 6).
plan_fact_checks.evidence: Query: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications current version year 2025 2026 genai.owasp.org (genai.owasp.org, owasp.org). Result: genai.owasp.org post under /2026/09/01/ titled 'OWASP GenAI Security Project Unveils 2026 Top 10 for LLM Applications, New Agent Control Standard ...'; the plan's URL was given as the download location. The 2025 edition remains as an archived resource; the owasp.org project page still shows 'Version 2025'.

plan_fact_checks.claim: NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3 is final since April 2025 (plan section 4 and section 16 item 7).

Results: nist.gov news item of 2025/04 'NIST Revises SP 800-61 ...' and the PDF nist.sp.800-61r3.pdf: finalized 2025-04-03, a CSF 2.0 Community Profile, supersedes Rev. 2 (marked withdrawn 2025-04-03).

plan_fact_checks.claim: OWASP WSTG: the stable documented release is 4.2 (plan section 4 and section 16 item 8).
